answer: Stop sybils with a nadir voyage canyon: an agent stakes a bond for one canyon voyage. It descends to its nadir and files a depth reading; verifiers match the reading to the voyage log, voiding a voyage whose reading is copied or claimed twice, slashing the bond. Forging 1,000 needs 1,000 voyages at 19x each: each reading fits one canyon and one voyage, and cannot be copied, shared, or bulk-bought. Honest agents voyage once, keeping rights.
